searchText: Lag up to a day Rafael posted this screenshot from the beacon node some time ago <tersec> what are the blue and green data series? A fix has been deployed. We synced up our fork with the beaconchain master and that seems to have quite a few disk related improvements. We tested it on a staging instance and were able to sync from scratch. Its been deployed to prod today and hopefully that fixes it, just needs some time to catch up. Worst case we'll just switch the URL to point to the staging instance. If you need the explorer asap for anything, i can just point you to the staging instance temporarily. <tersec> nothing urgent, no Green: Read, Blue: Write
